_readme: Copy to config.json next to unity-slot.ps1 (git-ignored) or to %USERPROFILE%\.unity-slot\config.json, then edit. Every key is optional: a missing key keeps the built-in default shown here. Keys starting with _ are comments. Text may use {home}, {repo}, {state} and %VARIABLES%.
_editorRoots: Folders that hold <version>\Editor\Unity.exe. The Unity Hub's custom install folder is added automatically.
_scanRoots: Folders whose subfolders are clones, for scan. Example value; the default is none (pass -ScanRoot).
_cloneRoot: Where new-clone creates clones. Empty: next to the template clone.
_maxEditors: acquire and new-clone refuse to start more editors than this. 0 keeps the registry value (6).
_standbyWorkers: Passed as -standbyWorkerCount. Unity 6000.6 rejects 0. -1 = do not pass it.
_python: Python for .py hooks. Empty: UNITY_SLOT_PYTHON, then python on PATH.
_timeouts: Seconds. stalled = when wait reports a starting editor as stalled. hook = per hook unless the hook sets timeoutSec.
_purposeRules: First guess at a new slot's purposes during scan, from the folder name without the repository name (the suffix) and the platform. You confirm or change them with set.
_platformAliases: Extra names for platforms in -BuildTarget, acquire and set.
_hooks: Programs to run per event (README: Hooks). enabled:false keeps an entry without running it.
